title: Viral Genomic Sequencing using Illumina Viral Surveillance Kit
author: Qing Yang
materials: Select “Start” Option on tablet screen to begin.
Scan or enter Maxwell kit bar code.
Transfer samples, reagents and elution buffer for each extraction as directed by the extraction kit technical manual.
Program a thermal cycler with the following:
Prepare reagents as follows: Bring IPB, EPH3, and RSB to room temperature. Thaw FSA, RVT, and SMM on ice.
While the program is running, ensure FSA and RVT reagents are thaw and kept cold. Invert to mix, DO NOT VORTEX, and quickly spin down.
Return all reagents back in their respective boxes at the correct temperature.
Prepare the reagents as follows: Bring ST2, TWB, EBLTL, EPM, TB1, and the Index Adapter Plate to room temperature. Thaw EPM on ice.
Thoroughly vortex the Tagmentation Master Mix to resuspend.
Prepare the reagents as follows: Bring IPB and RSB to room temperature.
Use a small-volume pipette to remove residual EtOH.
Quality Control and Pooling for Enriched Library
Preparing the MiSeq Legacy for a Run

steps.title: Specimen Receipt and Storage
steps.instruction: Receive specimens confirmed for viral genomes. Store unextracted specimens at 2-8°C if extraction is within 72 hours; otherwise, store at -80°C or colder. If using pre-extracted samples, store at -80°C and skip to library preparation.

steps.title: Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for extraction using Lysis Buffer and Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Label sterile 1.7 mL Eppendorf tubes with specimen numbers.
Pipette 200 µL of each specimen into the labeled tubes.
Store leftover unextracted specimens in 2.0 mL cryovial tubes at -80°C or colder.
Add 200 µL of Lysis Buffer and 20 µL Proteinase K to each tube.
Touch vortex for 10–15 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Maxwell CSC 48 Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total nucleic acid using the Promega Maxwell CSC 48 instrument.

substeps.instruction: Change gloves before handling cartridges, RSC plungers, and elution tubes.
Place cartridges in deck trays with well #1 facing away from elution tubes and snap into position.
Peel back seals completely, ensuring all adhesive is removed.
Place an empty elution tube in the designated position for each cartridge and add 50 µL Nuclease-Free Water to the bottom of each tube.
Transfer the total volume (420 µL) of sample lysate to well #1 of the cartridge.
Place a plunger into well #8 of each cartridge.
Select cartridge positions and enter sample tracking information on the tablet PC; press Proceed.
Add cartridges, press firmly to snap in place, and insert deck trays into the instrument.
Initiate the vision system scan via the tablet PC.
Once completed, select Open Door, cap elution tubes, remove deck trays, and discard cartridges.
Aliquot the elution into 8-strip tubes (3 aliquots of 12.5 µL each) and store at -80°C or lower.

steps.title: RNA Denaturation
steps.instruction: Denature RNA using the VSP_Den_RNA program.

substeps.instruction: Keep RNA on ice until ready. Inside an AirClean, add 8.5 µL of RNA sample or total nucleic acid to each well of a PCR plate.
Add 8.5 µL of EPH3 to each well.
Mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Seal with Microseal ‘B’ and centrifuge for 3 seconds at 280g.
Run VSP_Den_RNA program (Preheat lid 100°C, Vol: 17 µL; Step 1: 65°C for 5 min, Step 2: 4°C Hold).
Once in 4°C hold, centrifuge the plate for 10 seconds at 280g.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize first strand cDNA using the VSP_FSS program.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mix per sample: 9 μL FSA and 1 μL RVT. Pipette to mix.
Remove seal from PCR plate and add 8 µL of master mix to each well.
Pipette to mix and centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g.
Run VSP_FSS program (Preheat lid 100°C, Vol: 25 µL).
Centrifuge the plate for 10 seconds at 280g upon completion.

steps.title: Second Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize second strand cDNA using the VSP_SSS program.

substeps.instruction: Thaw SMM on ice; invert to mix and spin down (DO NOT VORTEX).
Add 25 µL of SMM to each well and mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Seal with Microseal ‘B’ and centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g.
Run VSP_SSS program (Preheat lid 40°C, Vol: 50 µL).
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g upon completion.

steps.title: DNA Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Tagment DNA and purify using Illumina Purification Beads (IPBs).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend IPBs and add 90 µL to each well.
Seal with Microseal ‘B’, shake for 1 minute at 2200rpm, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g, place on magnetic stand until clear (~5 min), and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice: add 175 µL fresh 80% EtOH, wait 30 seconds, and discard supernatant.
Remove residual EtOH with a small-volume pipette and air-dry on magnetic stand for 2 minutes.
Add 19.5 µL RSB to each well, seal, shake for 1 minute at 2600rpm, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g, place on magnetic stand until clear (~4 min), and transfer 17.5 µL supernatant to a new PCR plate.
Prepare Tagmentation Master Mix: 11.5μL TB1, 11.5μL EBLTL, and 14.5μL Water.
Add 32.5 µL of master mix to each well, pipette to mix, seal, and run VSP_TAG program (Preheat lid 100°C, Vol: 50 µL).
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Add 10 µL of room-temperature ST2 to each well, seal, shake for 1 minute at 2200rpm, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g and place on magnetic stand until clear (~3 min), then discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice: add 100 µL TWB, shake for 1 minute at 2000rpm (or pipette resuspend), centrifuge 3 seconds at 280g, and place on magnetic stand until clear (~3 min) before discarding supernatant.
Perform a third wash with TWB, but do not discard supernatant yet.

steps.title: Tagmented DNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify tagmented DNA using the VSP_TAG_PCR program.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR Master Mix: 23μL EPM and 23μL Water. Invert 10 times and spin down.
Discard TWB supernatant and any remnants using a small-volume pipette.
Immediately add 40 µL of PCR Master Mix and 10 µL of UD indexes to each well.
Pipette to mix, seal, and run VSP_TAG_PCR program (Preheat lid 100°C, Vol: 50 µL).

steps.title: Library Clean Up
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified library using IPBs.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate for 10 seconds at 280g and place on magnetic stand until clear (~3 min).
Transfer 45 µL supernatant to a MIDI plate.
Add 81 µL vortexed IPBs to each well, seal, shake for 1 minute at 2200rpm, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand until clear (~5 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 175 µL fresh 80% EtOH (wait 30 seconds per wash) and discard supernatant.
Remove residual EtOH and air-dry on magnetic stand for 2 minutes.
Add 17 µL RSB, seal, shake for 1 minute at 2700rpm, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min), and transfer 15 µL supernatant to a new PCR plate.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Pooling
steps.instruction: Quantify libraries and pool for hybridization.

substeps.instruction: Quantify libraries using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay (Target: >10 ng/μL for clinical/environmental; <1 ng/μL for NTC/DPC).
Pool undiluted libraries: 1-plex (7.5 µL sample) or 3-plex (2.5 µL per sample).

steps.title: Hybridization
steps.instruction: Perform hybrid capture using the VSP_HYB program.

substeps.instruction: Preheat thermal cycler to 50°C (lid off).
Prepare consumables: Vortex EHB2; Vortex NHB2, incubate at 50°C for 5 min, vortex 3x (10s each), and keep at 50°C; Vortex and thaw Illumina Viral Surveillance Panel v2 on ice.
On the 50°C thermal cycler, add to a new PCR plate: 7.5 µL pooled library, 12.5 µL NHB2, 2.5 µL Panel v2, and 2.5 µL EHB2.
Pipette to mix, seal, centrifuge for 3 seconds at 280g, and run VSP_HYB program (Preheat lid 100°C, Vol: 25 µL).
Incubate at 58°C for 90 minutes to 24 hours (18-24 hours recommended).

steps.title: Capture and Washing
steps.instruction: Capture hybridized probes and perform washes at 58°C.

substeps.instruction: Set thermal cycler with deep-well module to incubator function at 58°C (lid preheat 70°C).
Prepare consumables: Bring ET2, SMB3, EE1, EEW, and HP3 to room temperature; thaw EPM and PPC on ice.
Prepare EE1 (pipette mix), EEW (vortex, heat to 58°C), ET2 (vortex), HP3 (vortex), and SMB4 (vortex/invert).
Centrifuge sample plate at 280g for 10 seconds.
Add 62.5 µL SMB4 to each well, resuspend by pipetting, seal, and incubate at 58°C for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge at 280g for 10 seconds, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min), and discard supernatant.

Perform three EEW washes: add 50 µL preheated EEW, seal, shake at 2600rpm for 2 minutes, incubate at 58°C for 5 minutes, centrifuge at 280g for 3 seconds, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min), and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Transfer Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Perform transfer wash and elute the enriched library.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL preheated EEW, seal, shake at 2600rpm for 1 minute, and centrifuge at 280g for 3 seconds.
Transfer 50 µL to a new PCR plate, seal, and centrifuge at 280g for 3 seconds.
Incubate at 58°C for 5 minutes, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min), and discard supernatant.
Remove residual liquid with a small-volume pipette.
Prepare Elution Master Mix: 28.5 μl EE1 and 1.5 μl HP3. Pipette to mix.
Add 23 µL Elution Master Mix to each well, seal, shake at 2600rpm for 1 minute, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 280g for 10 seconds, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min), and transfer 21 µL supernatant to a new 96-well PCR plate.

steps.title: Enriched Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the enriched library using the VSP_AMP program.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 µL ET2 to each well, pipette to mix, seal, and centrifuge at 280g for 30 seconds.
Add 5 µL PPC (inverted/centrifuged) and 20 µL EPM (inverted/centrifuged) to each well.
Seal, shake at 2000rpm for 1 minute, and centrifuge at 280g for 10 seconds.
Run VSP_AMP program (Preheat lid 100°C, Vol: 50 µL).

steps.title: Final Library Clean Up
steps.instruction: Perform final purification of the enriched library.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate for 10 seconds at 280g and place on magnetic stand until clear (~3 min).
Transfer 45 µL supernatant to a MIDI plate.
Add 81 µL vortexed IPBs, seal, shake for 1 minute at 2200rpm, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand until clear (~5 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 175 µL fresh 80% EtOH (wait 30 seconds per wash) and discard supernatant.
Remove residual EtOH and air-dry on magnetic stand for 2–3 minutes.
Add 32 µL RSB, seal, shake for 1 minute at 2600rpm, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 280g, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min), and transfer 30 µL supernatant to a new PCR plate.

steps.title: Final Quantification and Pooling
steps.instruction: Quantify and normalize the final library pools.

substeps.instruction: Quantify pools using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Calculate pooling ratio and combine individual pools based on normalized volumes to ensure equivalent ng amounts.
Quantify final loading pool using Qubit and SpectraMax reader.
Determine fragment size distribution using Tapestation 4200 (High Sensitivity D5000 DNA screen tap); target peak is ~300-400bp.

steps.title: Sequencing Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the instrument and reagents for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Ensure 100GB space on instrument storage; upload sample sheet to Local Run Manager.
Thaw reagent cartridge and HT-1 (HYB) buffer on ice or at 2-8°C (RT water bath: ~1hr/24hr life; 2-8°C: 8-12hr/3 day life).
Equilibrate flow cell to room temperature for at least 10 minutes.
Invert reagent cartridge 10 times, inspect for precipitates, and tap on bench to remove bubbles.
Store thawed cartridge and HT-1 buffer at 2-8°C until loading.

steps.title: Library Denaturation and Loading
steps.instruction: Denature the pooled library and dilute to the final loading concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.2N NaOH by adding 400 µL molecular water to 100 µL of 1N NaOH; vortex to mix.
Add 5 µL pooled library and 5 µL 0.2N NaOH to a new tube; vortex and spin down.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add 990 µL chilled HT-1 (HYB) buffer and place on ice.
Dilute to recommended loading concentration (e.g., MiSeq V2: 10pM – 15pM).
